  alice  Villager   bob    Villager   carol  Doctor     dave   Werewolf
  erin   Werewolf   frank  Villager   grace  Seer

Night 1  (7 living)
  carol protects alice
  dave  devours alice
  erin  devours bob
  grace investigates alice  ->  Village
  no one died

Day 1  (7 living)
  alice -> frank   bob   -> carol   carol -> bob     dave  -> alice
  erin  -> alice   frank -> grace   grace -> erin
  no one was lynched

Night 2  (7 living)
  carol protects erin
  dave  devours carol
  erin  devours bob
  grace investigates dave  ->  Werewolves
  carol is devoured   (Doctor)

Day 2  (6 living)
  alice -> grace   bob   -> grace   dave  -> alice   erin  -> bob
  frank -> grace   grace -> erin
  no one was lynched

Night 3  (6 living)
  dave  devours frank
  erin  devours frank
  grace investigates frank  ->  Village
  frank is devoured   (Villager)

Day 3  (5 living)
  alice -> erin    bob   -> dave    dave  -> alice   erin  -> alice
  grace -> dave
  no one was lynched

Night 4  (5 living)
  dave  devours alice
  erin  devours grace
  grace investigates bob  ->  Village
  alice is devoured   (Villager)

Werewolves win after 4 rounds.  Survivors: bob, dave, erin, grace

Rewards
  alice -1   bob   -1   carol -1   dave  +1
  erin  +1   frank -1   grace -1
